# Review, pass 1 (units only) — secret-history-186-188

Files read: conventions.md, runbook.md, run3/RUNBOOK.md §2, packet.md, units.json, known-forms.json, the published glossary. No translation opened or recalled. `units.json` edited in place by script (`t` and word counts verified unchanged; every word's Ming bracket re-checked against the packet, 354/354). Units are numbered U0–U44 in file order (U0 = first §186 unit, U7 = first §187, U20 = first §188).

Counts: critical 0 · major 2 · moderate 7 · minor 12 · nit 4 (25 changes).

## Findings refused (left as drafted)

- U17 · i ("did not come to the end of them"): the note already gives the rival reading (not delivering them) and both rest on Ming 不到 alone. Left; the note carries the doubt.
- U4 · aburun, -urun glossed "converb of time: when -ing" while the note says "simply 'taking'": the glossary's bolurun entry has the same label, and the note explains the sense. Left.
- U31 · Qān-(n)i-jan Seṅgüm-i as apposition; U34 · erelesü "let me take"; U43 · accusative Kököčü aγtači-ji read as subject: all flagged uncertain in the notes and the l keeps the case; no better reading from the Ming. Left.
- ge- 'to cast aside' (U31, U40, U44): matches the published entries for gežü, gebe. A completive auxiliary is likely (čabčižu gebe = "cut down"), but the glossary entry is the house line. Left; see doubts.
- -dqun "imperative, polite plural": glossary uses "plural command"/"polite plural imperative" interchangeably. Left.
- U25 · "crept up on them" for marijažuγ̇u: i loose but l and note exact. Left.
- U21 · "fell in with" for orožuγ̇u: note says "came into the hands of". Left.
- U1 · Suldudai kept as a clan name in l and i (Ming 姓(名)); glossary has Süldüsün 'the Suldus' but the printed form differs. Left.
- Morph "Kököčü, a boy's or man's name": follows the glossary.

## Remaining doubts

- γ rendering in names is not uniform in the house: Qahan (γ→h), but Taqai, Sorqaqtani, Dongqaid (γ→q). Taqai and Dongqaid are fixed by the glossary; Sorqaqtani is new and follows them. Owner may want a rule.
- ge-: is it the 'say/do' auxiliary rather than 'cast aside'? Would change gežü, gebe, and the i of U44 ("cut him down and cast him aside").
- U30 speaker, U34 optative/conditional -sü, U17 kürgen, U18 who cuts whom, U21 usurγarun subject: all genuinely open from the Ming alone.
- Sub-glossary check (gloss.json) is for pass 2.

## House renderings for conventions.md (added by 186-188)

- Names in `i`: Taqai-Ba'atur (with Suldudai kept as printed), Jaqa Gambu (not hyphenated), Ibaqa-Beki, Sorqaqtani-Beki, Tolui, Badai, Kishiliq, Wang Qan, Qori-Sübechi, Kököchü, Senggum, Eme (a wife, not a name), Didig-Saqal, Negün-Usun, Chul, Abji'a-Ködegeri, Olon-Dongqaid, Tümen-Tübegen, Ongjid Kereid, Jirgin, Naiman.
- γ̇ → ' (Abji'a), as Ba'atur, Cha'ur, Ongjid.
- tusa-jin in-ü / an-u tula → "in return for the service of …"; amin žaγ̇ura → "at risk of one's life" (uncertain); kilgün (Ming 轅條) "shaft"; nögöġe kilgün bol → "Be a second shaft!".
- Decree formula: žarliγ bolurun → "issued a decree:"; -dqun → "plural command"; oluγsaγ̇ar / alaγsaγ̇ar → "take it as you win / kill it".
- aγtači (Ming 管馬的) → "groom" in `i`, "gelding-keeper" in `l`; emutü → "wife-having"; noγai miγ̇urtai → "dog-faced".
- Ming 名的 for ündür: 'name' reading noted; ündür "high" kept.
